name: Claude Sandbox
description: Runs Claude Code inside a Docker sandbox with a default-deny outbound firewall. This isn't a general-purpose development container; it exists to give Claude a contained environment where it can only reach an explicit allow-list of hosts.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the container. The host's $TZ takes precedence when it is set.

phpVersion.description: PHP version to install. The feature compiles from source, so a version it cannot fetch fails the image build rather than falling back. 'latest' tracks whatever upstream calls current at build time.

dockerSocket.description: Host Docker socket to expose inside the container, letting Claude drive containers you already run on the host (docker compose exec, Laravel Sail, wp-cli). Leave it at /dev/null to keep Docker out of the sandbox: the socket is root on the host, so anything that can reach it can escape the container entirely. /var/run/docker.sock covers Docker Desktop and standard Linux.

dockerHost.description: Value for DOCKER_HOST inside the container. The default is the Docker CLI's own default, and with dockerSocket left at /dev/null it resolves to nothing, which is the point. Set it to unix:///var/run/docker-proxy/docker.sock to use the filtered socket from .devcontainer/socket-proxy.yml instead — that route keeps dockerSocket at /dev/null, so the real socket is never mounted and container creation is refused.

workspaceFolder.description: Folder name to mount this project under /workspaces inside the container. Claude keys its session history by path, so projects sharing a name share their history in the common config volume. The default resolves to the name of your project folder on the host.
